**Make vector of numbers**

```{r}
my_numbers<-c(2,4,6,8)
sum(my_numbers)
```

**Using pipe symbol**

```{r}
mu_numbers<-c(2,4,6,8)
my_numbers|>sum()
```

**Perform a series of functions**

```{r}
my_numbers<-c(2,4,6,8)
print(my_numbers|>
        sum()|>
        sqrt())
```
```{r}
my_numbers<-c(2,4,6,8)
print(my_numbers|>
        sum()|>
        sqrt()|>
        round())
```
```{r}
my_numbers<-c(2,4,6,8)
my_result<-my_numbers|>
  sum()|>
  sqrt()|>
  round()
print(my_result)
```

**Exercise - Using the pipe operator**

```{r}
input_vec<-c(5,-10,4,-3)
result<-input_vec|>
  mean()|>
  abs()|>
  round()
print(result)
```

**Exercise - Making comparison**

1. y is equal to 7
```{r}
y<-12
print(y==7)
```
2. y is less than 15
```{r}
y<-12
print(y<15)
```
3. y is greater than 20
```{r}
y<-12
print(y>20)
```
4. y is less than or equal to 12
```{r}
y<-12
print(y<=12)
```
